deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds an unsourced link by stating that the slice through a tumour 'illustrates this' (linking it to biologists explanting tumours), whereas the lecturer only stated that the audience is looking at a slice through a tumour and a stain to look at morphology, without stating that it illustrates explantation.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
